scene:
Three zones read left to right, with no zone titles or headings above them.

LEFT ZONE, the requirement: at the top an unlabelled figure in a suit (no caption under the figure, no name) with a speech bubble labelled MORE FLEXIBLE. A downward navy arrow leads from the bubble to a document card with a small globe icon and two stacked lines of text on it: SECOND COUNTRY, and below it PAID WITHIN 12 MONTHS next to a small calendar icon.

MIDDLE ZONE, three stacked option cards, each with one simple icon; a dashed arrow runs from the requirement card to the three cards. Top card: a plug connecting to a small cloud service box, labelled A: SUPPLIER €60K + €40K/YEAR. Middle card: a tidy set of drawers pulled out of a cabinet on the left; to its right a single text block reading B: OWN THE RULES €140K (this card's only price is €140K); below that text block, a large ochre check mark next to a small stamp labelled CHOSEN, neither overlapping the text. Bottom card: a large crane lifting a whole building, labelled C: REPLACE €1.3M, crossed with a thin navy line and labelled TOO BIG.

RIGHT ZONE, top half: a simple line chart of cumulative cost over four years, horizontal axis with exactly four unlabelled tick marks. An ochre line for A starts low and rises steadily as a straight diagonal; a teal line for B is flat and horizontal. The two lines cross at the second tick, marked with a small circle labelled LEVEL AT YEAR 2. At the right end of the chart, the ochre line's end point is labelled 4 YEARS: A €220K and the lower teal line's end point is labelled 4 YEARS: B €140K.
RIGHT ZONE, bottom half: three wooden signposts in a row, each with one small icon: a two-way switch arrow on the post labelled SWITCH, an hourglass on the post labelled DEFER, a magnifying glass on the post labelled REASSESS.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: MORE FLEXIBLE, SECOND COUNTRY, PAID WITHIN 12 MONTHS, A: SUPPLIER €60K + €40K/YEAR, B: OWN THE RULES €140K, CHOSEN, C: REPLACE €1.3M, TOO BIG, LEVEL AT YEAR 2, 4 YEARS: A €220K, 4 YEARS: B €140K, SWITCH, DEFER, REASSESS. No zone headings or titles. The figure in the suit has no label. No axis numbers, no year numbers on the ticks. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An investor's speech bubble saying more flexible becomes a requirement card for a second country with customers paid within twelve months; three option cards follow, the supplier service at €60,000 plus €40,000 a year, owning the rules at €140,000 marked chosen, and replacing the system at €1.3 million marked too big; a cost chart shows the two lines level at year two and, over four years, €220,000 for A against €140,000 for B; three signposts read switch, defer and reassess.
caption: From a vague request to a recovered requirement, three priced options, the years of use that decide between them, and the signals that would change the choice.
